div.span:
• Human Decision Time: Multi-step user booking, catalog browsing & data entry
• Disconnected HTTP Requests: Multiple distinct request/response round-trips
• Zero Cross-Request Locks: Never hold JDBC connections across human think-time
• Resource Starvation Trap: Holding DB connections causes HikariCP pool exhaustion

div.span:
• Physical Incompatibility: Relational ACID boundary != Multi-screen user session
• Cascading Failures: Hanging worker threads lead to cascading service restarts
• Isolation Boundary: Application-level locks must bridge the disconnected steps
• Reversible Failure: Stale edits must abort safely without corrupting shared state

div.span:
• Sub-Second Execution: Spring @Transactional boundaries scoped to single requests
• ACID Guarantees: Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation, Durability at storage engine
• Short Connection Leases: Borrow from pool, update, commit, return immediately
• Verification Point: Offline tokens evaluated atomically during commit phase

div.span:
• Non-Blocking Validation: Detects concurrent overwrites without holding locks
• JPA @Version Mechanics: WHERE id = :id AND version = :clientVersion
• Low-Contention Fit: Highly scalable when conflict probabilities remain low
• Conflict Reconciliation: Spring OptimisticLockingFailureException -> HTTP 409

div.span:
• High-Contention Defense: Reserves scarce resources (hotel rooms, concert seats)
• Time-Bounded Lease: SET lock:room:101 session_id NX PX 600000 (10 min TTL)
• Safe Atomic Release: Lua script guarantees only lock owner can release key
• Heartbeat Renewal: Extends expiration during active multi-step browser session

div.span:
• Aggregate Protection: Locks root entity to protect all child items from race conditions
• Eliminates Phantom Edits: Prevents simultaneous child additions without root version bump
• OPTIMISTIC_FORCE_INCREMENT: JPA increments root version on child mutations
• Unit of Work Scope: Coordinates aggregate consistency across transaction boundaries

div.span:
• Stateless Web Containers: Externalizes session state away from JVM heaps
• Zero Sticky Sessions: Any cluster instance serves any incoming HTTP request
• Rolling Deploy Safety: Node restarts & autoscaling events never drop checkout state
• Central Invalidation: Instantaneous revocation upon checkout completion or logout

div.span:
• Encapsulated Third-Party APIs: Bridges to external GDS, inventory & payment networks
• Strict Timeout Budgets: Spring 6 RestClient with connect (1s) & read (3s) limits
• Circuit Breaker Isolation: Resilience4j fails fast to prevent worker pool saturation
• Intention-Revealing Contract: Domain invokes pure interface; wire protocol is hidden

• Contract in Domain Package: Inversion of Control decoupled from implementations
• Infrastructure Modules: StripePaymentGateway, GdsInventoryGateway, MockStubs
• Spring Bean Resolution: @ConditionalOnProperty swaps providers without code edits
• Special Case / Null Object: Polymorphic anonymous & zero-discount implementations
